The design image governs colour/material appearance, but its perspective and lighting MUST NOT be copied.
LIGHTING: this is a TEXTURE SOURCE (albedo). Even flat shadowless light from viewer; no cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light, no background, no floor. Paint subtle material wear without directional shading. Glowing parts are painted at their glowing colour, with no light cast on surroundings. No text labels or watermark.
Critical: retain guide_back.png exact silhouette and geometry and 1024x1024 composition. Return unresized 1024x1024 transparent PNG.
